company.name: Evernote
company.shortDescription: Evernote is a suite of software and services that allow users to capture, organize, and find information across multiple platforms.
company.description:
Evernote builds apps and products that are defining the way individuals and teams work today. As one workspace that lives across people's phone, tablet and computer, Evernote is the place people write free from distraction, collect information, find what they need and present their ideas to the world. Whatever peole are working toward, Evernote’s job is to make sure they get there. 

Evernote is an independent, privately held company headquartered in Redwood City, California. Founded in 2007, Evernote products reach more than 100 million users worldwide. With nearly 400 employees and growing, they are always looking for talented individuals to join their global team.

aiResearchSummary.text: Evernote is researching systems for content associations and sharing for scheduled events, content sharing by pointing to content, and related notes and multi layer search in personal and shared content. Work on fast identification of images in documents and automatic protection of partial document content supports secure, efficient capture. Additional efforts include contextual identification of information feeds during content entry and extracting structured data from handwritten and audio notes, covering capture, organization, retrieval and protection.

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Series E round raised $20,000,000, or 6.9% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.
caveats: Crunchbase reports 12 rounds but provides 10 detailed rows.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $1,000,000,000 to $1,000,000,000, a 1x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.title: Sharp recent attention and growth momentum
insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 17 (-7 over 90 days) and market heat at 8 (+2).
insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
caveats: Crunchbase does not expose the complete weighting behind these proprietary scores.

insights.title: Strategic repositioning and listing coverage shape the current narrative
insights.statement: Evernote has a recent strategic-positioning change; 1 recent unique news titles explicitly contain the English terms IPO or listing.
insights.implication: Their timing coincides with increased visibility in the loaded news and Crunchbase momentum signals, but the data does not establish causation.
caveats: The causal link to Crunchbase momentum is an inference from timing, not a disclosed company metric.
